vidēbō

vidēbō, faciam, erō

the future tense

I will see, do, be

In this lexicon

  • will

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Att. 12.2.2: jam tē vidēbō; Plaut. Men. 225c: Jam ego hīc erō.

  • Jam tē vidēbō.: see you soon

    classical

Examples

  • Redī citō. — Jam ego hīc erō.

    Come back soon. — I’ll be right back.Plaut. Men. 225b–225c
